equation_request.abstract: Recently, reversible circuit synthesis has been intensively studied. One of the problems that has not been solved for a long time was exact minimization of gate count (GC) in 4-bit circuits. Finally, last year a tool of practical usage for finding optimal gate count Toffoli networks for any 4variable function was developed. However, not much work has been done yet on exact minimization of quantum cost (QC) in 4-bit circuits. This paper presents an application of the above mentioned tool to reducing QC of 4-bit reversible circuits. It is shown that for benchmarks and for designs taken from recent publications it is possible to obtain savings in QC of up to 74% comparing with previously known circuits.

specification.problem: Exact or near-exact minimization of gate count and quantum cost (QC) of 4-bit reversible circuits built from Toffoli-type (NCT) gates. The abstract only states that an existing optimal-gate-count tool is applied to reduce QC; no algorithm details are given.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Tiny instance: a 4-bit reversible function as a permutation of {0..15}, a Toffoli-gate network realizing it, and a quantum cost sum over gates. The tool's internal search, the benchmarks, and the 74% savings result are outside scope and not reconstructed.

equations.label: Circuit realization
equations.description: A cascade of reversible gates implements f.
equations.justification: Standard definition of reversible circuit synthesis; the abstract does not state it.
assumptions: Gates applied in order G_1 first

equations.label: Gate count minimization
equations.description: Optimal gate count over library L of Toffoli-type gates.
equations.abstract_quote: finding optimal gate count Toffoli networks for any 4variable function
equations.justification: The abstract says the tool finds optimal-gate-count Toffoli networks; the formula is a formalization.
assumptions: L is the NCT-style library of NOT, CNOT, Toffoli

equations.label: Quantum cost of a circuit
equations.description: Total quantum cost as additive sum of per-gate costs.
equations.justification: Common cost model in reversible synthesis; the abstract does not give the cost values.
assumptions: Commonly used values c(NOT)=1, c(CNOT)=1, c(Toffoli)=5 (recalled, not from abstract)

equations.label: QC minimization objective
equations.description: Goal of reducing QC; the minimum may need more gates than GC(f).
equations.abstract_quote: exact minimization of quantum cost (QC) in 4-bit circuits
equations.justification: The abstract names QC minimization as the target; the formal objective is inferred.
assumptions: Search is over the same gate library
How the tool is used to reach QC-optimal circuits is not specified

equations.label: Relative saving
equations.description: Percentage QC saving versus a previously known circuit.
equations.abstract_quote: savings in QC of up to 74% comparing with previously known circuits
equations.justification: The percentage definition is the natural reading of the claim; the abstract states no formula.
assumptions: Saving defined relative to the old QC

steps.description: Specify target 4-bit permutation f and gate library with per-gate costs.
Use an optimal-GC synthesis tool to obtain minimal-gate Toffoli networks (details not given).
Select or search for the circuit that minimizes QC (mechanism unspecified) and compute saving versus known circuits.

Instance is a generic 4-bit permutation, not a specific benchmark
